decisions.reason: Acceptance of the bulkier enclosure form does not change the existing requirements for a solid base or resistance to rattling and shifting.
The client accepts the current machine form but does not change the platform height, cup clearance, or edge-to-edge footprint alignment.
The accepted bulkier machine enclosure does not alter the specified 4.5-quart bowl capacity, bowl depth, or refill policy.
The source decision concerns enclosure bulk and button placement, not the beige finish or green accent colors.
The possible future logo exploration concerns base graphics and does not change the established Elena's Chai Whisk placard text, position, sides, or orientation.
Accepting the current bulkier enclosure does not revise or remove the DJ-turntable-inspired visual theme.
The enclosure-form acceptance does not change splash-control targets, speed conditions, or mitigation options.
The source does not change the requirement that the bowl seal prevent liquid from reaching the electronics.
The client only states an intention to explore a possible new logo; no replacement graphic, typography, or color decision is established.
Acceptance of the bulkier enclosure form does not alter any mixing-quality, texture, foam, or high-speed behavior requirement.
The accepted placement refers to the spout on/off controls, while the dedicated central machine power button remains a separate topic whose method is unchanged.
The enclosure-form decision does not change the selected stainless-steel whisk design, material, or size requirements.
